subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do workflow owners approve this grouped update of 14 executable action revisions after a current-main refresh and targeted validation of the secret-bearing and publishing paths?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but accepting new executable action revisions in privileged automation is a supply-chain and operational-risk choice that the protected `security` label reserves for maintainers.

options.title: Refresh and validate together
options.body: Rebase or regenerate the group, verify all upstream revisions, and land it after the sensitive workflow checks are green.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, Docker publish, CodeQL, and Codex Action updates from lower-risk setup and housekeeping actions for narrower review.

options.title: Hold the dependency refresh
options.body: Keep the existing pins until workflow owners have capacity to inspect and validate the upstream changes.

recommendation.title: Refresh and validate together
recommendation.body: Rebase or regenerate the group, verify all upstream revisions, and land it after the sensitive workflow checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline and recent release-workflow history make steipete the strongest available owner for accepting the grouped automation and security boundary change.
